title: Formspec UI Graph Policy
description: Structural source contract for UI Graph Policy v0.1. This document constrains a loaded Surface graph with module Locale key ownership, route-level accessibility policy, responsive route slot collapse order, hidden Definition references, and Theme token assignments to module widget token slots. It is host-loaded evidence only in v0.1: it is not an App Manifest sibling slot, not an ArtifactResolver group, not an AppGraphValidator implementation, not ModuleResolver token-slot authority, not runtime hidden-state behavior, and not an authorization policy.

$formspecUiGraphPolicy.description: UI Graph Policy document version. MUST be '0.1'.

x-lm.intent: Version pin for UI Graph Policy document compatibility

version.description: Version of this UI Graph Policy document. MUST be a strict SemVer 2.0.0 string.

targetSurface.description: Canonical Surface identity this UI Graph Policy document constrains.

x-lm.intent: Surface identity anchor for policy-to-graph matching

localeKeyOwners.description: Module ownership declarations for $module.* Locale key prefixes. Prefix collisions, prefix-to-moduleId matching, and unresolved module ids are semantic app-graph checks, not structural schema checks.

routePolicies.description: Route-scoped policy entries keyed by Surface routes[].id. Full route coverage and duplicate route policy checks are semantic app-graph checks.

x-lm.intent: Route-scoped policy declarations consumed by later graph validation

url.description: Canonical Surface URL this policy constrains. The policy document MUST NOT infer Surface identity from source path, filename, URL suffix, or route name.

version.description: Optional exact version or range expression. Compatibility is checked by app-graph semantics.

keyPrefix.description: Owned Locale key prefix beginning with $module.<moduleId>. and ending with a dot.

routeId.description: Surface routes[].id this policy entry targets.

landmark.description: Route-level landmark category. A web renderer may map validated projected main, navigation, or complementary policy to a route-root layout container role under the UI Graph Policy route-landmark profile. Region remains metadata-only until a profile supplies an accessible-name contract; broader ARIA synthesis and platform mapping remain out of scope.

keyboardNavigation.description: Whether the route-level policy profile requires keyboard navigation support.

collapseOrder.description: Ordered Surface route slot ids used by the route's responsive collapse policy. Slot resolution is an app-graph semantic check.

hiddenDefinitionRefs.description: Definition refs hidden by route policy. Loaded Definition resolution and route-local form-slot checks are semantic app-graph checks.

assignments.description: Theme token assignments to module widget token slots. Widget and slot resolution is deferred to ModuleResolver/Registry evidence.

token.description: Raw Theme token key from a loaded Theme tokens map, such as 'color.accent'. UI Graph Policy does not use '$token.<key>' reference syntax in this field.

widgetName.description: Module-contributed widget name. Contribution ownership is resolved by ModuleResolver, not this schema.
